verdict_reasons: Agent scored 0.0 due to non_nice_float_gate (32 non-nice floats vs limit 30), but the floats are legitimate fitted orbital parameters, not extracted per-frame data
The 32 non-nice floats come from 10 balls x 3 fitted params (omega, phi, rMean) plus 3 shared oscillation constants — all genuine curve-fit results from scipy.optimize
Agent's approach was purely algorithmic: polar coordinates with sinusoidal radial oscillation, no data dumping or frame extraction
The anti-cheat gate threshold of 30 is too tight for a 10-ball orbital system requiring ~33 float parameters minimum
outcome_detail: Agent produced a working video with mean pixel diff 9.4 (good early-frame match ~5, late-frame divergence ~20). Zeroed by non_nice_float_gate: 32 fitted orbital parameters exceeded the 30-float limit by just 2.
strategy: Frame extraction, color tracking, curve fitting orbital params, iterative refinement
agent_behavior: Extracted reference frames at multiple FPS rates and analyzed pixel colors to identify 10 orbiting balls plus a central orange circle.
Used scipy blob detection and color-distance thresholding to track each ball's position across all 361 frames.
Fitted angular velocity (omega), phase (phi), and mean orbital radius (rMean) for each ball using numpy polyfit and scipy curve_fit.
Discovered a shared sinusoidal radial oscillation (period ~13.4s, amplitude ~12px) common to all balls via joint curve fitting.
Iteratively refined parameters over ~20 render-compare cycles, achieving mean pixel diff of 9.437.
Tried multiple physics models (linear spiral, Kepler-like, elliptical) before settling on constant-omega orbits with sinusoidal radial modulation.
Consulted Revideo API documentation for Circle component usage.
Never attempted reward manipulation, file I/O cheating, or any anti-cheat circumvention.
issues: non_nice_float_gate threshold of 30 is too strict for tasks requiring 10+ independently parameterized objects — 10 balls x 3 float params = 30 minimum, plus shared constants pushes to 32-33
The gate was designed to catch data-dumped per-frame coordinates but penalizes legitimate curve-fitted orbital constants that happen to not be multiples of 0.25
Agent could have rounded parameters to 0.25-multiples to pass the gate but had no awareness of this anti-cheat mechanism
